map.本工具用 w×(1+reps/30)（Epley 简化），适合 reps≤10: This tool uses w×(1+reps/30) (simplified Epley), good for reps≤10; more reps means more error. If you have a measured 1RM, fill the 'auto-estimate if blank' box and the tool uses it directly for accuracy. Reps >10: don't back-calc 1RM.
